headline: Squat: The Water You Lose at Speed
subheadline: Depth − draught is not your UKC
insight: A ship sinks deeper as speed increases, especially in shallow water. Heel, swell and chart accuracy reduce the margin further. Small margin? Slow down.

sources.title: Resolution A.893(21): Guidelines for voyage planning

meta.description: Under-keel clearance is more than charted depth minus draught. Squat, heel, swell, chart accuracy and water density all reduce the real margin.
meta.question: What minimum UKC does your company require?
